reason: A store near Westchase with fitting rooms and staff who help with length is exactly what I want, and it's a short drive from where I already shop on weekends. If the crepe feels solid when I touch it, I'd pick up one thobe or abaya for upcoming weddings, but I won't fill a bag on the first visit.
objection: I don't know this brand's fabric. If the crepe is thin, see-through or scratchy like most of what I see on TikTok, I'm walking out with nothing, 15% off or not.
would_change_my_mind: If I feel the fabric and it's sheer or cheap, I won't buy. Fabric that's clearly good quality would make me come back for a second piece.
